en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a large medieval-style castle with towers and crenellated walls perched dramatically on top of a high, stratified limestone cliff. Dense forest covers the slopes below the cliff. In the foreground is a calm river with several small rowboats carrying people in early-20th‑century clothing and hats, suggesting leisure boating. The overall style is scenic and romantic, with no visible printed text on the image side.
